hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults instead of standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens from the pool manager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting externally while enforcing a proprietary curve invariant.
